def check():
    """Stuck = has ERROR, no done anywhere; start lines present; ids well-formed; sorted; out/stuck.txt written."""
    import re
    import glob
    starts, errs, dones = {}, set(), set()
    files = sorted(glob.glob('logs/app-*.log'))
    assert files, "no log files found"
    for f in files:
        for line in open(f):
            line = line.rstrip('\n')
            m = re.search(r'req-\d+', line)
            if not m:
                continue
            rid = m.group(0)
            low = line.lower()
            if re.search(r'\bstart\b', low):
                starts[rid] = True
            if 'error' in low:
                errs.add(rid)
            if re.search(r'\bdone\b', low):
                dones.add(rid)
    expected = sorted(rid for rid in starts if rid in errs and rid not in dones)
    lines = open('out/stuck.txt').read().splitlines()
    if lines == expected:
        return "PASS (stuck=%d, done=%d, err-no-start=%s)" % (len(expected), len(dones), sorted(errs - set(starts)))
    return "FAIL expected=%s got=%s" % (expected, lines)

for f in sorted(glob.glob('logs/app-*.log')):
    for line in open(f):
        m = re.search(r'req-\d+', line)
        if not m:
            continue
        rid = m.group(0)
        if re.search(r'\bstart\b', line):
            starts.add(rid)
        if re.search(r'\bERROR\b', line):
            errs.add(rid)
        if re.search(r'\bdone\b', line):
            dones.add(rid)
expected = sorted(r for r in starts if r in errs and r not in dones)

# Method 2: shell

set -e
grep -ohE "req-[0-9]+" logs/app-*.log | sort -u > /tmp/all.txt
grep -hE "ERROR" logs/app-*.log | grep -oE "req-[0-9]+" | sort -u > /tmp/err.txt
grep -hE "done" logs/app-*.log | grep -oE "req-[0-9]+" | sort -u > /tmp/done.txt
comm -23 /tmp/err.txt /tmp/done.txt > /tmp/stuck.txt
cat /tmp/stuck.txt

file_lines = open('out/stuck.txt').read().splitlines()
print("match:", file_lines == expected and g2.strip().split('\n') == expected)
